highlights.title: Live Editor
highlights.body: Edit and preview charts or diagrams

text.moreDetails:
Mermaid is a JavaScript based diagramming and charting tool. It generates diagrams flowcharts and more, using markdown-inspired text for ease and speed.

Mermaid live editor is available helps you edit and preview charts/ diagrams.

Please read our document to know how to use it!

+ Demo all charts and diagrams: https://toshihiro.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/MIFC/pages/338984978

+ Live Editor: https://toshihiro.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/MIFC/pages/338984961

FEATURES

  • Flow charts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, entity relationship diagrams, Gantt diagrams, pie charts, git graphs & user journey diagrams
  • Syntax validation, error highlighting & live preview
  • Confluence PDF/Word export
  • Download diagram as an image
  • Mermaid built-in themes
  • Version history
  • Search integration
  • Zero data retention policy
text.releaseNotes: Migrated the app from Atlassian Connect to Forge. This release improves platform compatibility and ensures continued support with Atlassian's latest cloud platform.
